intro: I listen by feeling, not by genre.

claim.headline: I don’t listen by genre. I listen by feeling.
claim.body: Pop takes up most of the data, but the pattern underneath is bigger: big feelings, dramatic lyrics, and songs I replay until they’re attached to a specific version of my life. Hindi and Punjabi songs keep culture in the mix, and old favorites almost never disappear. It’s less a taste profile than a very over-documented emotional archive.
